evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: The contract is framed around reliable, fast return — capability of the system and stability of the guarantee.
The appeal is to security and preservation of effort — no work is lost even under failure, a conservation-of-resources value.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The design gives the caller self-origination over how to retrieve results — poll or piggyback — an autonomy appeal.
